response.sql:
WITH source_counts AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux AS source, COUNT(*) AS spatial_record_count
  FROM scanspatial AS s
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(spatial_record_count) AS total_count,
         AVG(spatial_record_count) AS avg_count
  FROM source_counts
)
SELECT sc.source,
       sc.spatial_record_count AS count,
       CAST(sc.spatial_record_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share,
       sc.spatial_record_count - t.avg_count AS above_average
FROM source_counts AS sc
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
WHERE sc.spatial_record_count > t.avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: “Spatial survey coverage” means the number of scanspatial records per funding source; each matched spatial record counts once. Share is that source’s fraction of all matched spatial records, and the average is the unweighted average count across represented funding sources.
